meta.name: idempotency-side-effects-discipline

copy.tagline: 为有副作用的操作定义幂等键和重试策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在分布式系统中保证操作只执行一次
copy.tagline_en: Define idempotency keys and retry policies for side-effectful operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to guarantee exactly-once execution in distributed systems

howto.what: Claude 会为有副作用的操作定义幂等键、重试策略、去重和交付保证，并输出操作表，说明选择至少一次或恰好一次的理由。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理集成、任务或处理器的副作用操作，或需要防止重试导致的重复或不一致时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个支付接口定义幂等键和重试策略。
say.note: Claude 会生成操作表并说明保证类型。

say.text: 如何确保这个任务在重试时不会重复执行？
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出去重方案。

howto.what_en: Claude defines idempotency keys, retry policy, deduplication, and delivery guarantees for side-effectful operations, producing an operation table with at-least-once or exactly-once rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to handle side-effectful operations for integrations, jobs, or handlers, or needs to prevent duplicates or inconsistencies under retries.

say_en.text: Define idempotency keys and retry policy for this payment endpoint.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an operation table with guarantee rationale.

say_en.text: How to avoid duplicate execution on retry for this job?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and provide deduplication approach.
